text.aria-label: Title text 'A summer week at each decision substation: power and four forecasts'

g.text: A summer week at each decision substation: power and four forecasts

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Power as a percentage of the substation's effective capacity. Median forecast made one day ahead (left) and six days ahead (right) of each half-hour, against the observed power. Each substation's week is the 7-day block of the scored year in the summer months with the largest swing in observed power.'
